missing_evidence: Postgres server-side metrics: active/waiting connections, max_connections, pool wait time
Order service pool configuration and saturation logs
candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No direct Postgres metrics; pool exhaustion inferred from idle=0 and DependencyUnavailable errors.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s trace to order-service ReadTimeouts on /v1/orders; save_order spans show a saturated Postgres pool (size 5, idle 0) failing with DependencyUnavailable. Inventory and payment succeed, so the fault is bounded to the order-to-postgres path.
